nodes.label: ADR-011: Tenant-Scoped Azure Connection Control Plane
nodes.rationale: Extends the existing integration-profile control plane with tenant-bound lifecycle records in the public schema for Azure Blob and Azure PostgreSQL only, storing secret references (Vault-resolved outside local Compose) and non-sensitive metadata rather than (per Alternatives Considered) developer-managed profiles (can't meet self-service requirements), plaintext credential/config storage (violates secret-management controls), or arbitrary provider/connection-string input (cannot be safely validated as a finite catalog). Requires TLS, least-privilege read-only credentials, and a passing safe connection test plus governance approval before activation.

hyperedges.label: External tenant data boundary chain: base tenant isolation extended to Azure connections and contract-governed external SQL chat
